name: AOP entry reference synthetic preflight

on:
  push:
    branches: [tb371fc-aop-reference-ci-20261123-1148]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: aop-entry-reference-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  cortex-m3-reference:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - name: Install native QEMU build dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results"
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential git ca-certificates \
            python3 python3-venv python3-distlib ninja-build meson pkg-config \
            libglib2.0-dev libpixman-1-dev zlib1g-dev libfdt-dev
      - name: Record public inputs and check source syntax
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -E -B - "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results" <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
          out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
          names = ["hw/arm/qcom-aop-reference.c", "hw/arm/Kconfig",
                   "hw/arm/meson.build",
                   "configs/devices/aarch64-softmmu/aop-reference.mak",
                   "tb371fc/tests/test_aop_entry_reference.py",
                   "tb371fc/tests/test_aop_entry_xml.py",
                   "tb371fc/docs/aop-entry-reference.md"]
          def sha(path):
              with pathlib.Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
                  return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
          data = {"source_commit": subprocess.check_output(
                      ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
                  "sha256": {name: sha(name) for name in names},
                  "firmware_read": False, "firmware_executed": False}
          (out / "source-inputs.json").write_text(
              json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
          PY
          PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX="$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-pycache" \
            python3 -m py_compile tb371fc/tests/test_aop_entry_reference.py \
              tb371fc/tests/test_aop_entry_xml.py
          perl scripts/checkpatch.pl --no-tree --file hw/arm/qcom-aop-reference.c \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results/checkpatch.log"
          cc --version > "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results/compiler-version.txt"
          python3 --version > "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results/python-version.txt"
      - name: Build only the standalone reference configuration
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          repo="$PWD"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-build"
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-build"
          "$repo/configure" --target-list=aarch64-softmmu \
            --with-devices-aarch64=aop-reference --without-default-devices \
            --without-default-features --enable-system --enable-tcg --enable-fdt \
            --disable-docs --disable-tools --disable-guest-agent \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results/configure.log"
          ninja -j1 qemu-system-aarch64 \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results/build.log"
          ./qemu-system-aarch64 --version \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results/qemu-version.txt"
          sha256sum qemu-system-aarch64 \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results/qemu.sha256"
          ./qemu-system-aarch64 -machine help \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results/machines.txt"
          python3 -E -B - "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results/machines.txt" <<'PY'
          import pathlib, sys
          listing = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
          names = {line.split()[0] for line in listing.splitlines() if line.split()}
          assert "aop-entry-reference" in names, "AOP reference machine was not registered"
          PY
      - name: Require all target XML protocol regression tests
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          timeout --signal=KILL 30s python3 -E -B tb371fc/tests/test_aop_entry_xml.py -v \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results/xml-unit.log"
      - name: Run the fourteen public cases within an isolated process group
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -E -B - "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-build/qemu-system-aarch64" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/aop-reference-results" <<'PY'
          import datetime, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, signal
          import subprocess, sys, time, traceback
          qemu = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
          out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
          runner = pathlib.Path("tb371fc/tests/test_aop_entry_reference.py").resolve()
          inputs = json.loads((out / "source-inputs.json").read_text())
          def sha(path):
              with pathlib.Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
                  return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
          def group_exists(pgid):
              try:
                  os.killpg(pgid, 0)
              except ProcessLookupError:
                  return False
              return True
          command = [sys.executable, "-E", "-B", str(runner), "preflight", "--qemu",
                     str(qemu), "--out", str(out / "preflight")]
          receipt = {"schema": "aop-reference-public-ci-v1", "passed": False,
                     "command": command, "expected_checks": 14,
                     "firmware_read": False, "firmware_executed": False,
                     "maximum_seconds": 180,
                     "qemu_sha256_before": sha(qemu),
                     "runner_sha256_before": sha(runner),
                     "started_utc": datetime.datetime.now(
                         datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
          process = None
          started = time.monotonic()
          try:
              with (out / "preflight.log").open("xb") as log:
                  process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=log,
                      stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
                  receipt["process_group"] = process.pid
                  try:
                      receipt["exit_code"] = process.wait(timeout=180)
                  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
                      receipt["timeout"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__,
                                            "message": str(exc)}
                      try:
                          os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                          receipt["own_group_sigkill_sent"] = True
                      except ProcessLookupError:
                          receipt["group_already_exited"] = True
                      try:
                          receipt["exit_code"] = process.wait(timeout=5)
                      except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as reap_exc:
                          receipt["post_kill_wait_failure"] = str(reap_exc)
                          receipt["exit_code"] = process.poll()
              remaining = group_exists(process.pid)
              receipt["group_present_after_wait"] = remaining
              if remaining:
                  receipt["orphan_group_found"] = True
                  try:
                      os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                      receipt["orphan_group_sigkill_sent"] = True
                  except ProcessLookupError:
                      receipt["group_exited_before_cleanup"] = True
              assert "timeout" not in receipt, receipt
              assert receipt["exit_code"] == 0, receipt
              assert not remaining, "Synthetic runner left its process group alive"
              proof = json.loads((out / "preflight/result.json").read_text())
              assert proof["passed"] is True and proof["all_passed"] is True
              assert proof["expected_checks"] == len(proof["checks"]) == 14
              assert all(check["passed"] is True for check in proof["checks"])
              assert proof["firmware_read"] is False
              assert proof["firmware_executed"] is False
              assert proof["qemu_sha256"] == receipt["qemu_sha256_before"] == sha(qemu)
              assert proof["runner_sha256"] == receipt["runner_sha256_before"] == sha(runner)
              actual = {name: sha(name) for name in inputs["sha256"]}
              assert actual == inputs["sha256"], "Source changed during build or preflight"
              receipt["source_unchanged"] = True
              receipt["binary_unchanged"] = True
              receipt["result_sha256"] = sha(out / "preflight/result.json")
              receipt["passed_checks"] = 14
              receipt["passed"] = True
          except BaseException:
              receipt["failure"] = traceback.format_exc()
          finally:
              if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
                  try:
                      os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                      receipt["final_cleanup_sigkill_sent"] = True
                  except ProcessLookupError:
                      pass
                  try:
                      process.wait(timeout=5)
                  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                      receipt["worker_not_reaped"] = True
              receipt["wall_seconds"] = time.monotonic() - started
              (out / "ci-execution.json").write_text(
                  json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
          print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
          sys.exit(0 if receipt["passed"] else 1)
          PY
      - name: Upload all public logs and the tested binary
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: aop-entry-reference-synthetic-${{ github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/aop-reference-results/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/aop-reference-build/qemu-system-aarch64
      - name: State the measured boundary
        if: always()
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' \
            'This job builds the independent aop-entry-reference machine, requires eleven XML regressions (30-second bound) and fourteen synthetic Cortex-M3 checks (180-second bound).' \
            'Read ci-execution.json and preflight/result.json for the actual verdict; build failure, timeout, leaked process group or changed input fails the job.' \
            'The guest opcodes are authored test inputs. No private firmware is read or executed, and no AOP or TB371FC hardware boot is attested.' \
            'Before-access watchpoint checks cover the tested ordinary TCG accesses; they do not establish that internal exception stack/vector accesses stop before bus dispatch.' \
            >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

# QEMU TB371FC

[![AOP synthetic preflight](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/qemu-tb371fc/actions/workflows/aop-entry-reference.yml/badge.svg?branch=tb371fc-aop-reference-ci-20261123-1148)](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/qemu-tb371fc/actions/workflows/aop-entry-reference.yml)

## AOP 独立诊断参考：合成 CI 检查点

本分支加入独立的 `-M aop-entry-reference` 和单独的 `aop-reference` 构建配置，用于先验证后续固件诊断所依赖的访存监测方法。
首次 CI 的机型注册失败保留于 [attempt-01](tb371fc/evidence/aop-reference-ci-20261123/attempt-01/manifest.json)。
接口修复已在固定 `567e4f9` 的第二次 CI 及独立 CT 构建中确认；随后两次均因 QEMU `target.xml` 的未绑定 `xi:` 前缀解析失败，尚未执行合成来宾指令。
[CT XML 修复验证](tb371fc/evidence/aop-reference-ci-20261123/ct-attempt-03/manifest.json)使用同一冻结二进制，11 项 XML 回归全部通过；CPU 预检实际为前两项通过、第三项未映射读取失败、后续十一项未运行。
原停止包 `awatch:b0e604c` 表示监视区间起点；旧 runner 将其误作实际命中地址。[第二次 CI 原始回执](tb371fc/evidence/aop-reference-ci-20261123/attempt-02/manifest.json)和 CT 失败均保留。

本次加入严格 XML envelope 适配、11 项独立回归，以及仅在 vCPU 停止且持有 BQL 时可读的 watchpoint 命中快照。
runner 唯一关联 RSP 区间和实际命中，保留原精确地址、PC、总线、RAM 与 padding 检查。
**新修复仍待独立 CT 构建与完整 14 项实际通过；11 项 XML 或前两项 CPU 成功不代表 14 项通过。**

Cortex-M3、1 MHz 时钟、可选的低地址别名及额外 DTCM 都是明确的诊断参考配置，平板实际 AOP CPU 和冷启动映射尚未确认。
CI 只执行自编测试指令，不读取或运行私有固件。普通访存的 watchpoint 测试也不证明异常内部 vector/stack 访问具有停前保证。
脚本保留日志、失败结果和 socket 目录；CPU 预检具有 180 秒独立进程组总时限，CI 的 XML 回归另有 30 秒时限。

详见 [方法与边界](tb371fc/docs/aop-entry-reference.md) 和 [待验证检查点](tb371fc/evidence/aop-reference-ci-20261123/checkpoint.json)。
以下 TB371FC 功能测试记录属于已有的独立验证范围；本分支不宣称完整 AOP 服务、原厂 Android 或整机等价已经通过。

面向 **Lenovo TB371FC / SM8250（Kona）** 的整机模拟开发分支，基于 QEMU **11.1.3**，提供独立的 `-M tb371fc`。目标是实现真实来宾驱动可使用的软件可见硬件接口，并用平板的只读证据和实际运行的测试逐项核对。

**当前已实现并实际验证 Cortex-A77 架构模型、GENI FIFO、GCC、精确架构计数器与 MMIO timer、SMMUv2 stage 1、UFS 主机/PHY，以及显式启用的 RPMh 数字资源模型。**
独立的 upstream Linux 6.12.114 已完成八核用户态启动和真实 UFS/SMMU 驱动 I/O；未修改的平板生产内核也已在生成的设备树和测试 initramfs 下完成八项用户态检查及真实 guest shutdown。

**完整 Android 启动和整台平板等价仍是未通过的目标。**
生产内核加测试 initramfs 的成功不等于原厂 Android 系统启动。小核仍用 A55 代替 Qualcomm Kryo；显示、Adreno 650、触控、无线、音频、摄像头以及完整电源/固件契约仍有大量实现工作。缓存容量、功耗、射频、电气行为和真实芯片时序不由这些功能测试证明。

## TCSR、AOP 消息内存与 REFGEN 增量验证（2026-11-23）

本轮冻结二进制 SHA-256 为 `2173fa4da68f8f769c53942b056124c5621e4714652c7f572deacc9440ec09cf`。
[55/55 公共 gate](tb371fc/evidence/boot-resources-20261123-1005/public-55/result.json) 实际通过，包含 51 组组件/解析检查和四次 Linux 启动。
[50 项专项检查](tb371fc/evidence/boot-resources-20261123-1005/workflow.json) 包括 TCSR 24 项、AOP SRAM 10 项和 REFGEN 16 项；十次迁移尝试包括七次成功传输及三次预期的配置不匹配拒绝。

TCSR 实现 32 个互斥槽的所有者和未知状态；AOP SRAM 实现 4 KiB 存储与真实 RAM 迁移；REFGEN 实现 CTRL5 bit 0 软件请求和状态有效性。
行为与边界见 [TCSR](tb371fc/docs/tcsr-mutex.md)、[AOP SRAM](tb371fc/docs/aop-msgram.md)、[REFGEN](tb371fc/docs/refgen.md)。

[两次原厂内核与完整 DT 诊断](tb371fc/evidence/boot-resources-20261123-1005/native-progression.json) 均失败：
默认未知 REFGEN 状态仍在 `refgen_kona_is_enabled` 读取处中止；显式选择尚未实测的 disabled reference 后，推进到 `gdsc_probe -> regmap_mmio_read32le`。
此前 AOP 64 字节描述符读取异常未在这两次日志中出现，但 AOP 固件、QMP 握手和电源服务尚未验证。
**完整原生 DT 和 Android 启动仍未通过。** SMEM/SBL 交接、原生 PMIC 映射和未解析 regulator 等依赖继续保留为未完成项。

## 先前 QSEE 与 DCC 增量验证（2026-11-23）

该轮冻结二进制 SHA-256 为 `51fe61d35213a6602a8eaa865faba04bc85f88df341947ca8a2e6300a8ab5be6`。
[52/52 公共 gate](tb371fc/evidence/qsee-dcc-20261123/public-52/result.json) 实际通过，包含 48 组组件/解析检查和四次 Linux 启动。
[51 项专项检查](tb371fc/evidence/qsee-dcc-20261123/workflow.json) 包括 QSEE 12 项、真实迁移 6 项、DCC 新操作 16 项和原有 DCC 17 项。

QSEE 实现两组四位通知、mask/W1C、SPI 348/349 和状态迁移；DCC 实现有序单字 WRITE、平坦 LOOP 与单寄存器 RMW，执行真实内存事务。
[首次迁移脚本失败](tb371fc/evidence/qsee-dcc-20261123/initial-attempt/workflow.json) 与[脚本修正](tb371fc/evidence/qsee-dcc-20261123/harness-fix.json) 均保留；设备 C 代码和冻结二进制未因该修正改变。

未修改的生产内核加完整原生 DT 已越过 QSEE；[本轮实际故障](tb371fc/evidence/qsee-dcc-20261123/native-progression.json)
为 AOP mailbox 的 64 字节共享内存读取和 `refgen_kona_is_enabled+0x14`。
**完整原生 DT 和 Android 启动仍未通过。** QSEE 不是 TEE/SCM 执行实现，DCC 仍缺 CRC/ATB/CTI、嵌套循环等模式。
行为与限制见 [QSEE](tb371fc/docs/qsee-irq.md) 和 [DCC 操作](tb371fc/docs/dcc-operations.md)。

## 先前显示 RSC 增量验证（2026-11-23）

新增显示 RSC 的真实窗口和 SPI 129 接线，与三个 APPS 投票槽共享同一资源服务。
新二进制 SHA-256 为 `05c617462f87d5bacea9b86007ca8e37de5ed9a2644a5e3af5ac0d60485ec55b`。
[49/49 公共 gate](tb371fc/evidence/display-rsc-20261123/public-49/result.json) 已通过，包含 45 组组件/解析检查与四次 Linux 启动。
另有 [53 项 RPMh 专项检查](tb371fc/evidence/display-rsc-20261123/tests-final.json)，覆盖显示 11 项、显示迁移 6 项、APPS 22 项、APPS 迁移 5 项、文件配置 3 项及私有部分数据库的时钟 6 项。

同一原厂内核和完整私有设备树，配显式 SPMI reference 与部分 RPMh 文件配置，
已越过先前显示 RSC 和 SPMI 控制器访问异常；[该轮下一实际故障](tb371fc/evidence/display-rsc-20261123/native-progression.json) 是 `qsee_irq_probe+0x140`。
PMIC 路由、RPMh regulator 资源和 SBL/SMEM handoff 仍不完整。**原厂 Android 完整启动仍未通过。**
详细寄存器、共享投票和迁移边界见 [显示 RSC 文档](tb371fc/docs/rpmh-display-rsc.md)。

## 当前模型与明确边界

| 组件 | 当前契约 |
| --- | --- |
| CPU | QEMU index 0–3 为 A55 surrogate；4–7 为新增 `cortex-a77` r1p0 架构模型，实机大核 MIDR `0x411fd0d0`、REVIDR `3` 有只读证据。MPIDR 为 `0,0x100,…,0x700`。小核 ID 与实机 Kryo 不同；实际 cache 容量/ways/sets 未采得。 |
| RAM / loader | 默认 8 GiB，从 `0x80000000` 起，保留 Android 可见布局的 69 MiB 排除区。大 RAM 的 raw Image 分配基址为 `0xa0000000`，对应通常的 Image text `0xa0080000`；ELF 使用其链接地址。 |
| GIC / PSCI | QEMU GICv3 按实机地址和 affinity 接线；SMC PSCI 支持已验证的 SMP 与 system-off 路径。没有 Qualcomm EL3/TrustZone 或完整 OEM 启动链。 |
| Timer | CPU 和 MMIO 计数器默认用准确有理换算，`floor(ns×19200000/10^9)`；deadline 向上取整。`counter-exact=off` 只用于保留旧量化模式的兼容检查。 |
| GENI / GCC | FIFO 串口接入有状态 GCC 时钟/复位。QUP 2.5 version 寄存器仍明确为合成兼容值；部分 fabric 输入和启动时钟状态仍为公开的 bootstrap 假设。DMA/GSI、流控和真实 baud timing 未实现。 |
| SMMUv2 | apps/GPU 两个架构窗口，非安全 AArch64 stage-1、4 KiB 页表和真实 DMA 翻译；不冒充已实现 Qualcomm TCU/TBU、stage 2 或全部 QSMMU v500 扩展。GPU SMMU 的存在不等于 GPU 已实现。 |
| UFS | Sysbus HCI、Qualcomm wrapper、QMP PHY、GCC 依赖、SMMU DMA 与 SCSI 后端。使用显式测试磁盘。ICE、RPMB 认证、完整原生 LU 启动属性、全部错误/复位模式和物理 PHY/闪存时序仍未完成。 |
| RPMh | `rpmh-profile=off` 为默认值；`reference` 和 `file` 必须显式选择。file 解析外部 cmd-db 并核对内容；未知资源不会自动获得成功 ACK。它不执行 AOP 固件，也不模拟真实 PMIC 电压。 |
| 迁移 | GENI、GCC、timer、RPMh、watchdog、TLMM 和 IMEM/PS_HOLD 有各自的实际迁移回执。**上游 UFS core 当前阻止整板迁移**；组件测试显式使用 `ufs-enabled=off`。SMMU 与其他未验收状态不能由这些回执推定。 |

# Bounded QEMU AOP entry reference

This is an independent diagnostic reference. Its public workflow reads no
private firmware. The current instrumentation fix still requires a new build
and all fourteen actual synthetic preflight checks.

| Preserved attempt | Actual result |
| --- | --- |
| [attempt-01](../evidence/aop-reference-ci-20261123/attempt-01/manifest.json) | Build completed; missing ARM target interface prevented machine selection. No synthetic guest instruction ran. |
| [attempt-02](../evidence/aop-reference-ci-20261123/attempt-02/manifest.json) | CI run 45175027472 built and registered the machine. Unbound `xi:` in QEMU's `target.xml` then failed ElementTree parsing before guest execution. The separate CT1230 build reproduced that parser failure. |
| [CT attempt-03](../evidence/aop-reference-ci-20261123/ct-attempt-03/manifest.json) | Same frozen CT binary; all 11 XML regressions passed. The first two CPU checks passed, the third failed, and the remaining eleven were not reached. The old runner confused the RSP range base with the actual overlap address. |

The XML adapter only normalizes the exact source-derived QEMU target envelope.
Malformed XML, unknown prefixes, other annexes, duplicate attributes and recursive
includes remain rejected. The new read-only hit snapshot corrects address
observation without relaxing the precise address, PC, RAM, padding or unsupported
bus-callback requirements. Neither the earlier 11 XML passes nor two CPU passes
constitutes fourteen-check acceptance.

The selected CPU is upstream QEMU Cortex-M3. The captured AOP image establishes
ELF32 little endian, EM_ARM=40 and Thumb entry candidates; it does not identify
the actual AOP core, its cold reset mapping, its clocks, or its peripheral state.
The diagnostic must retain `hardware_reset_verified=false` and
`aop_startup_validated=false`, even after a bounded run produces a useful first
unsupported-access address.

## Why the previous engine was stopped

The preserved Unicorn 2.1.4 preflight failed its mapped-tail write check. Calling
`emu_stop()` in a valid-memory write hook still changed the destination from
`44332211` to `88776655`. The prior unmapped read, SCS read and mapped-tail
read checks passed; the final shared-alias check was not reached. No firmware
was read or executed by that preflight. The failure concerns the instrumentation
method, not AOP hardware.

The original harness, corrected Cortex-M3 constructor version, preflight
failure and CPU-model API probe remain under
`/work/aop-reset-reference-20261123`. They must not be overwritten or relabeled
as successful.

## Exact input-derived memory geometry

The private source image is 524288 bytes with SHA256
`3dbb0746d21100d124d76ee19b096d122d58c4aa534dec5828005835535b6671`.
Only the five PT_LOAD entries are used. Each has alignment four and equal
file/memory sizes. Non-LOAD headers and their separate memory-size fields do not
allocate guest RAM.

| Segment | File offset | Physical/virtual address | File and memory bytes | ELF flags |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 2 | 0x3000 | 0x0b000000 | 0x14f08 | R-X |
| 3 | 0x17f10 | 0x0b0e0000 | 0x604c | RW- |
| 4 | 0x1df60 | 0x80800000 | 0xdfc8 | RW- |
| 5 | 0x2bf28 | 0x80810000 | 0x1384 | RW- |
| 6 | 0x2d2ac | 0x80818000 | 0x47b0 | RWX |

These are loader-derived reference ranges, not measured physical bank sizes.
The candidate stack value 0xe8000 is outside every writable ELF LOAD range.

The ELF entry is 0x0b000009. The first two words of the executable LOAD yield
candidate MSP=0xe8000 and candidate reset PC=9. The words are not proof of a
measured reset ABI.

## Three independent profiles

- `elf-physical-entry`: map only the five physical ranges and explicitly enter
  the ELF entry with the candidate stack value.
- `local-alias-vector`: additionally map code at zero and data at 0xe0000 using
  aliases of the exact same QEMU RAM backings; explicitly enter candidate PC9.
- `local-alias-dtcm32k-reference`: the second profile plus an explicit data
  region extension from 0x604c to 0x8000, adding 8116 unmeasured bytes. Only this
  profile makes the word immediately below candidate MSP writable.

The machine's initial reset reads occur before the RSP controller loads image
bytes. Initial vector placement and zeroed RAM are reference construction
choices. The runner records the actual QEMU initial register state separately
from the later entry/SP overrides. It does not present the overrides as a
native reset observation.

One Cortex-M3, a fixed 1 MHz required CPU clock, and 32 unconnected NVIC inputs
are reference configuration. They are not AOP clock, IRQ-count, or CPU identity
measurements. Bit-banding is disabled. No remote processor, device response,
heap hook, function replacement, interrupt injection, or peer acknowledgement
is present.

## Strict accesses

Every RAM block has page-rounded host backing, but only an exact-size alias is
mapped into guest address space. Hidden padding is filled with 0xa5 and exposed
only to a read-only host QOM integrity check. It is not additional guest RAM.

The entire unused 32-bit space returns MEMTX_ERROR. A high-priority guard also
covers 0xe0000000..0xe00fffff in the ARMv7M container. This matters because normal
upstream ARMv7M supplies SCS/SysTick devices and privileged PPB RAZ/WI defaults.
The guard must not allow these unknown AOP accesses to succeed implicitly.

The RSP controller installs hardware watchpoints over every hole and write
watchpoints over ELF read-only regions. This QEMU revision sets ARM's
`gdb_stop_before_watchpoint=true`; TCG converts the requests to
`BP_STOP_BEFORE_ACCESS`. Its check restores vCPU state, sets EXCP_DEBUG, and
exits the CPU loop before the offending access is dispatched. The runner never
resumes a watchpoint-faulted instruction.

This is not instruction-transaction rollback. STRD/STM or split unaligned
stores may have earlier legal bus beats. Tests require forbidden target
padding and all unrelated RAM to remain unchanged, require no unsupported
bus callback to run, and preserve any earlier valid writes in the receipt.
They also require the precise expected first forbidden overlap byte, so a different
exception-stack access cannot accidentally satisfy the test.

GDB's RSP stop packet reports the configured watch range base (`vaddr`),
not the access hit. The read-only `watchpoint-hits` QOM property is available
only with BQL held and the vCPU stopped. It preserves raw flags and
macro-decoded state. The runner requires an empty initial snapshot, uniquely
matches this packet's range/type and the installed length, checks
before-access/read/write state, and compares `hitaddr` with
`target + allowed_prefix`. The value is the first overlap byte,
`MAX(access_address, watch_range_base)`, not an architectural FAR or an
access-width report. Evidence is taken before continuing execution; the
faulted instruction is never resumed. No CPU watchpoint flags, registers,
memory or device state are changed by this observer.

Before each single-step request the controller checks the PC against executable
file ranges and checks the whole two- or four-byte Thumb instruction extent.
The T16/T32 length split is the same top-five-bit rule used by this revision's
Thumb translator. Known blocking/trap encodings stop the reference diagnostic;
all other instruction semantics are executed by QEMU. No Capstone dependency
or replacement instruction interpreter is used.

## Internal exception accesses have a separate boundary

In the fixed base revision, `arm_v7m_load_vector()` calls
`address_space_ldl()` directly, and `v7m_stack_write()/v7m_stack_read()`
perform direct physical accesses after address translation.
These paths do not call `cpu_check_watchpoint()`.
The fourteen ordinary TCG access checks therefore do not prove that internal
exception vector or stack accesses stop before bus dispatch. Earlier legal
stack writes can remain visible. A failed vector read is escalated rather than
using the guard's zero value as a successful response.

The existing private runner stops after observing a nonzero IPSR and rejects
changed unsupported-callback counters or hidden padding. Its
`architectural-exception-after-step` outcome is a bounded exception
observation, with no internal-exception before-access guarantee. This public
CI does not call the private command. Before a later private diagnostic, its
machine-readable verdict must explicitly retain that limitation; a passing
synthetic run does not remove it.

## Process and directory retention

Before each QEMU process is started, its result directory receives
`launch.json` with the exact command, the actual socket-directory path and
`retained=true`. The harness does not delete its temporary socket directories.
QEMU logs, launch records, partial results and failed attempts remain available
for review.

Normal instance teardown requests QMP quit before closing RSP, waits up to one
second, then kills and reaps that QEMU process if it has not exited. This avoids
resuming a stopped guest merely by disconnecting the debugger. Public CI must
also bound the entire synthetic preflight to 180 seconds in its own process
group. The separate XML regression step has a 30-second CI bound; the private
command's separate ten-second profile bound does not apply to preflight.

## Public preflight first

The proposed preflight has 14 top-level checks:

1. Actual Cortex-M3 QOM type and an authored MRS MSP instruction.
2. Permitted guest STR/LDR.
3. Unmapped read stopped before a value is supplied.
4. Unmapped write stopped before bus dispatch.
5. PPB read and write, including SCS and SysTick locations.
6. A read just beyond an exact range inside its host backing page.
7. A write to that same logical tail.
8. An unaligned STR spanning an exact range boundary.
9. STRD across a boundary, with an independent permitted two-word control.
10. STM across a boundary, with an independent permitted two-word/writeback
    control and recorded earlier legal beats.
11. ELF read-only code write.
12. Guest writes through both real aliases and execution from the code alias.
13. A T32 instruction crossing the executable file end and a non-executable PC.
14. Extra DTCM exists only in the explicit reference profile.

The opcodes used by preflight are self-authored; they are not copied from the
private firmware. Exact count, boolean verdict, runner hash and QEMU binary hash
must all match before the private command accepts an image path.

## Bounded private execution

Use a fresh output directory for every attempt:

```sh
python3 tb371fc/tests/test_aop_entry_reference.py preflight \
  --qemu /work/build-aop-reference-20261123/qemu-system-aarch64 \
  --out /work/aop-qemu-preflight-01

# Run only after reviewing the real 14-check preflight result.
python3 tb371fc/tests/test_aop_entry_reference.py diagnose-private \
  --qemu /work/build-aop-reference-20261123/qemu-system-aarch64 \
  --preflight /work/aop-qemu-preflight-01/result.json \
  --firmware /work/device-assets/current-aop_a-20261123.bin \
  --out /work/aop-qemu-diagnostic-01
```

Each profile runs in a fresh process, with at most 4096 single-step attempts and
a ten-second parent-enforced wall deadline. On timeout the parent kills the
entire private Python/QEMU process group; it does not leave a detached QEMU
running after the debugger disconnects.

A completed diagnostic means the instrumentation produced a bounded outcome.
A first unsupported address, architectural exception, blocking instruction, or
budget stop is not a firmware boot success. Completed single-step count does
not claim cycle accuracy or architectural retirement for a partially executed
faulting multi-access instruction.

Private raw image bytes, memory images, logs containing private state, and
register snapshots remain private. A public summary may retain input/tool
hashes, selected profile assumptions, counter values, and first fault address
and location after review. It must not publish firmware bytes, disassembly, or
per-opcode low-entropy hashes.

def digest(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def save(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def layout(profile):
    result = [list(x) for x in PHYSICAL]
    if profile == PROFILES[2]:
        result[1][1] = 0x8000
    if profile != PROFILES[0]:
        result += [[0, result[0][1], 5], [0xe0000, result[1][1], 6]]
    return result


def contains(ranges, address, size, flag=4):
    return size > 0 and any(flags & flag and base <= address and
                           address + size <= base + length
                           for base, length, flags in ranges)


class QMP:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        self.sock.settimeout(2)
        self.sock.connect(str(path))
        self.file = self.sock.makefile("rb")
        greeting = json.loads(self.file.readline())
        assert "QMP" in greeting, repr(greeting)
        self.next_id = 0
        self.call("qmp_capabilities")

    def call(self, name, arguments=None):
        self.next_id += 1
        request = {"execute": name, "id": self.next_id}
        if arguments is not None:
            request["arguments"] = arguments
        self.sock.sendall(json.dumps(request).encode() + b"\n")
        while True:
            raw = self.file.readline()
            assert raw, "QMP disconnected"
            reply = json.loads(raw)
            if reply.get("id") != self.next_id:
                continue
            assert "error" not in reply, reply
            return reply.get("return")

    def get(self, name):
        return self.call("qom-get", {"path": "/machine", "property": name})

    def close(self):
        self.file.close()
        self.sock.close()


def parse_gdb_feature_xml(name, raw):
    """Adapt QEMU's exact target.xml envelope for ElementTree namespaces."""
    # gdbstub/gdbstub.c emits this envelope followed by literal xi:include
    # elements, without xmlns:xi. Bind that documented inclusion name only
    # in this parser copy; malformed XML and other unbound prefixes still fail.
    prefix = (b'<?xml version="1.0"?>'
              b'<!DOCTYPE target SYSTEM "gdb-target.dtd"><target>')
    if name == "target.xml" and raw.startswith(prefix):
        raw = (prefix[:-len(b"<target>")] +
               b'<target xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">' +
               raw[len(prefix):])
    return ET.fromstring(raw)


class RSP:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        self.sock.settimeout(2)
        self.sock.connect(str(path))
        self.buffer = bytearray()
        self.history = []
        self.packet("qSupported:multiprocess+;qXfer:features:read+")
        initial = self.packet("?")
        assert initial[:1] in (b"S", b"T"), initial
        self.registers = {}
        self._next_register = 0
        self._read_feature("target.xml", set())
        for name in ("r0", "r1", "r2", "sp", "lr", "pc", "xpsr", "msp",
                     "psp", "control", "primask", "basepri", "faultmask"):
            assert name in self.registers, (name, self.registers)

    def byte(self):
        if not self.buffer:
            data = self.sock.recv(65536)
            assert data, "RSP disconnected"
            self.buffer.extend(data)
        value = self.buffer[0]
        del self.buffer[0]
        return value

    def receive(self):
        while True:
            value = self.byte()
            if value == ord("-"):
                raise RuntimeError("RSP peer rejected packet checksum")
            if value == ord("$"):
                break
        encoded = bytearray()
        while True:
            value = self.byte()
            if value == ord("#"):
                break
            encoded.append(value)
        received = int(bytes((self.byte(), self.byte())), 16)
        assert sum(encoded) & 0xff == received, "RSP checksum mismatch"
        self.sock.sendall(b"+")
        decoded = bytearray()
        i = 0
        while i < len(encoded):
            value = encoded[i]
            i += 1
            if value == ord("}"):
                assert i < len(encoded)
                decoded.append(encoded[i] ^ 0x20)
                i += 1
            elif value == ord("*"):
                assert decoded and i < len(encoded)
                count = encoded[i] - 29
                assert count >= 0
                decoded.extend(bytes((decoded[-1],)) * count)
                i += 1
            else:
                decoded.append(value)
        return bytes(decoded)

    def packet(self, payload):
        raw = payload.encode()
        assert all(x not in raw for x in (b"$", b"#", b"}", b"*"))
        self.sock.sendall(b"$" + raw + b"#" +
                          ("%02x" % (sum(raw) & 0xff)).encode())
        result = self.receive()
        # Record packet kinds only: no private image bytes or register payloads.
        self.history.append(payload.split(":", 1)[0].split(",", 1)[0][:32])
        return result

    def xml(self, name):
        offset = 0
        chunks = []
        while True:
            reply = self.packet("qXfer:features:read:%s:%x,800" % (name, offset))
            assert reply[:1] in (b"m", b"l"), reply
            chunks.append(reply[1:])
            offset += len(reply) - 1
            if reply[:1] == b"l":
                return parse_gdb_feature_xml(name, b"".join(chunks))

    def _read_feature(self, name, visited):
        assert name not in visited, "Recursive GDB target XML"
        visited.add(name)
        tree = self.xml(name)
        for node in tree.iter():
            local = node.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]
            if local == "include":
                self._read_feature(node.attrib["href"], visited)
            elif local == "reg":
                number = int(node.attrib.get("regnum", self._next_register))
                bits = int(node.attrib["bitsize"])
                self.registers[node.attrib["name"]] = (number, bits)
                self._next_register = number + 1

    def reg(self, name):
        number, bits = self.registers[name]
        value = self.packet("p%x" % number)
        assert len(value) == bits // 4 and b"x" not in value, (name, value)
        return int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(value.decode()), "little")

    def set_reg(self, name, value):
        number, bits = self.registers[name]
        reply = self.packet("P%x=%s" %
                            (number, value.to_bytes(bits // 8, "little").hex()))
        assert reply == b"OK", (name, reply)
        assert self.reg(name) == value, (name, value, self.reg(name))

    def read(self, address, size):
        result = bytearray()
        while len(result) < size:
            length = min(1024, size - len(result))
            raw = self.packet("m%x,%x" % (address + len(result), length))
            assert len(raw) == length * 2 and not raw.startswith(b"E"), raw[:80]
            result.extend(bytes.fromhex(raw.decode()))
        return bytes(result)

    def write(self, address, data):
        for offset in range(0, len(data), 512):
            chunk = data[offset:offset + 512]
            reply = self.packet("M%x,%x:%s" %
                                (address + offset, len(chunk), chunk.hex()))
            assert reply == b"OK", (hex(address + offset), reply)

    def guards(self, ranges):
        ordered = sorted(ranges)
        cursor = 0
        installed = []
        for base, length, flags in ordered:
            assert cursor <= base, "Overlapping visible ranges"
            if base > cursor:
                installed.append((4, cursor, base - cursor))
            if not flags & 2:
                installed.append((2, base, length))
            cursor = base + length
        if cursor < 2**32:
            installed.append((4, cursor, 2**32 - cursor))
        for typ, base, length in installed:
            assert self.packet("Z%x,%x,%x" % (typ, base, length)) == b"OK"
        return [{"type": t, "base": b, "length": n} for t, b, n in installed]

    def step(self):
        stop = self.packet("s")
        assert stop.startswith(b"T05") or stop == b"S05", stop
        return stop.decode()

    def close(self):
        self.sock.close()


class Reference:
    def __init__(self, qemu, output, profile=PROFILES[0]):
        output.mkdir()
        self.output = output
        self.profile = profile
        self.qmp = self.rsp = self.process = self.log = None
        self.socket_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="aopq-", dir="/tmp"))
        self.initial = None
        try:
            self.log = (output / "qemu.log").open("wb")
            command = [str(qemu), "-M", "aop-entry-reference,profile=" + profile,
                       "-accel", "tcg,thread=single", "-S", "-nodefaults",
                       "-display", "none", "-monitor", "none", "-serial", "none",
                       "-no-reboot", "-no-shutdown",
                       "-qmp", "unix:" + str(self.socket_dir / "qmp") +
                       ",server=on,wait=off",
                       "-gdb", "unix:" + str(self.socket_dir / "gdb") +
                       ",server=on,wait=off"]
            save(output / "launch.json", {
                "phase": "before-process-start", "command": command,
                "socket_directory": str(self.socket_dir), "retained": True})
            self.process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=self.log,
                                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
            while not all((self.socket_dir / x).exists() for x in ("qmp", "gdb")):
                assert self.process.poll() is None, "QEMU exited during startup"
                assert time.monotonic() < deadline, "QEMU socket startup timeout"
                time.sleep(.005)
            self.qmp = QMP(self.socket_dir / "qmp")
            self.rsp = RSP(self.socket_dir / "gdb")
            cpus = self.qmp.call("query-cpus-fast")
            assert len(cpus) == 1, cpus
            children = self.qmp.call("qom-list", {"path": "/machine/armv7m"})
            assert any(x["name"] == "cpu" and
                       x["type"] == "child<cortex-m3-arm-cpu>" for x in children)
            expected = ";".join("0x%x:0x%x:%d" % tuple(r) for r in layout(profile))
            assert self.qmp.get("reference-layout") == expected
            assert self.qmp.get("padding-pristine") is True
            self.initial = self.state()
            self.start_bus_counts = self.counts()
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def state(self):
        names = ["r%d" % i for i in range(13)] + ["sp", "lr", "pc", "xpsr",
                 "msp", "psp", "control", "primask", "basepri", "faultmask"]
        return {name: self.rsp.reg(name) for name in names}

    def counts(self):
        return [self.qmp.get("unsupported-read-count"),
                self.qmp.get("unsupported-write-count")]

    def prepare(self, instruction, address=CODE, registers=None):
        self.rsp.write(address, instruction)
        self.rsp.set_reg("xpsr", 0x01000000)
        self.rsp.set_reg("sp", 0xe8000)
        self.rsp.set_reg("pc", address)
        assert self.rsp.reg("msp") == 0xe8000
        for name, value in (registers or {}).items():
            self.rsp.set_reg(name, value)
        self.watchpoints = self.rsp.guards(layout(self.profile))

    def snapshot(self):
        return {base: self.rsp.read(base, size)
                for base, size, flags in layout(self.profile)[:5]}

    def close(self):
        if self.process is not None and self.process.poll() is None:
            if self.qmp is not None:
                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                    self.qmp.call("quit")
            try:
                self.process.wait(timeout=1)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                self.process.kill()
                self.process.wait(timeout=1)
        if self.rsp is not None:
            self.rsp.close()
        if self.qmp is not None:
            self.qmp.close()
        if self.log is not None:
            self.log.close()

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *unused):
        self.close()


def watch_address(stop):
    for key in ("watch", "rwatch", "awatch"):
        marker = key + ":"
        if marker in stop:
            return int(stop.split(marker, 1)[1].split(";", 1)[0], 16)
    return None


def negative(qemu, output, instruction, target, allowed_prefix=0,
             profile=PROFILES[0]):
    with Reference(qemu, output, profile) as r:
        values = {"r0": 0x55667788, "r1": target, "r2": target,
                  "r3": 0xa1b2c3d4}
        # STRD/STM use r0 and r1 as payload and r2 as the base.
        if instruction in (bytes.fromhex("c2e90001"), bytes.fromhex("03c2")):
            values["r1"] = 0xa1b2c3d4
        r.prepare(instruction, registers=values)
        before = r.snapshot()
        initial_registers = r.state()
        bus = r.counts()
        stop = r.rsp.step()
        final_registers = r.state()
        after = r.snapshot()
        assert watch_address(stop) == target + allowed_prefix, stop
        assert final_registers["pc"] == CODE, final_registers
        assert r.counts() == bus, "Unsupported bus callback ran before watchpoint"
        assert r.qmp.get("padding-pristine") is True
        changes = []
        for base in before:
            for i, (old, new) in enumerate(zip(before[base], after[base])):
                if old != new:
                    address = base + i
                    assert target <= address < target + allowed_prefix, hex(address)
                    changes.append({"address": address, "old": old, "new": new})
        if not allowed_prefix:
            assert before == after
        else:
            expected = struct.pack("<II", values["r0"], values["r1"])
            for change in changes:
                assert change["new"] == expected[change["address"] - target]
        # A load must not receive a synthesized value from a forbidden target.
        if instruction == bytes.fromhex("0868"):
            assert final_registers["r0"] == values["r0"]
        return {"stop": stop, "fault_address": watch_address(stop),
                "pc_before": CODE, "pc_after": final_registers["pc"],
                "invalid_backing_padding_unchanged": True,
                "unsupported_callbacks_unchanged": True,
                "earlier_legal_byte_writes": changes,
                "register_changes": {k: [initial_registers[k], v]
                                     for k, v in final_registers.items()
                                     if v != initial_registers[k]},
                "resumed_after_fault": False}


def instruction_size_and_stop(rsp, ranges, pc):
    if not contains(ranges, pc, 2, 1):
        return None, "unsupported-instruction-fetch"
    first = int.from_bytes(rsp.read(pc, 2), "little")
    size = 2 if first >> 11 < 0x1d else 4
    if not contains(ranges, pc, size, 1):
        return None, "instruction-crosses-executable-file-boundary"
    second = int.from_bytes(rsp.read(pc + 2, 2), "little") if size == 4 else None
    stop = (size == 2 and (first in (0xbf20, 0xbf30) or
            first >> 8 in (0xbe, 0xde, 0xdf))) or (
            size == 4 and ((first == 0xf3af and second in (0x8002, 0x8003)) or
            (first & 0xfff0 == 0xf7f0 and second & 0xf000 == 0xa000)))
    return size, "blocking-or-exception-instruction" if stop else None

             negative(args.qemu, path(7), bytes.fromhex("0860"), end))

             negative(args.qemu, path(8), bytes.fromhex("0860"), end - 2, 2))
        def multi(instruction, valid_path, invalid_path, writeback):
            target = PHYSICAL[2][0] + 0x100
            with Reference(args.qemu, path(valid_path)) as r:

                          "r1": 0xa1b2c3d4, "r2": target})
                stop = r.rsp.step()

                assert r.rsp.read(target, 8) == struct.pack("<II", 0x55667788,
                                                          0xa1b2c3d4)

                assert r.rsp.reg("r2") == target + (8 if writeback else 0)
                valid = {"actual_two_word_store": True,
                         "base_writeback": writeback}

                               end - 4, 4)

        case("strd-crosses-exact-boundary", lambda:
             multi(bytes.fromhex("c2e90001"), 15, 9, False))
        case("stm-records-earlier-permitted-beats", lambda:
             multi(bytes.fromhex("03c2"), 16, 10, True))
        case("read-only-code-write", lambda:
             negative(args.qemu, path(11), bytes.fromhex("0860"),
                      PHYSICAL[0][0] + 0x200))

            with Reference(args.qemu, path(12), PROFILES[1]) as r:
                alias = 0xe0100

                r.prepare(bytes.fromhex("08600860"), address=0x100, registers={
                    "r0": 0x11223344, "r1": alias})
                r.rsp.step()
                assert r.rsp.read(physical, 4) == struct.pack("<I", 0x11223344)
                r.rsp.set_reg("r0", 0x55667788)
                r.rsp.set_reg("r1", physical)

        case("real-shared-code-and-data-aliases", aliases)
        def fetch():
            with Reference(args.qemu, path(13)) as r:
                end_code = PHYSICAL[0][0] + PHYSICAL[0][1]
                r.rsp.write(end_code - 2, bytes.fromhex("00f0"))

                    r.rsp, layout(PROFILES[0]), end_code - 2)
                assert width is None
                assert reason == "instruction-crosses-executable-file-boundary"
                width, reason = instruction_size_and_stop(
                    r.rsp, layout(PROFILES[0]), PHYSICAL[1][0])
                assert width is None and reason == "unsupported-instruction-fetch"

        case("t32-tail-and-nonexecutable-fetch-guards", fetch)
        def extension():
            with Reference(args.qemu, path(14), PROFILES[2]) as r:

                    "r0": 0xabcdef01, "r1": target})
                stop = r.rsp.step()
                assert watch_address(stop) is None
                assert r.rsp.read(PHYSICAL[1][0] + 0x7ffc, 4) == struct.pack(

        assert len(result["checks"]) == PREFLIGHT_CHECKS
        result["passed"] = result["all_passed"] = True
    except BaseException:
        result["failure"] = traceback.format_exc()
    save(out / "result.json", result)
    return 0 if result["passed"] else 1


def parse_firmware(data):
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_IMAGE
    head = struct.unpack_from("<16sHHIIIIIHHHHHH", data)
    assert head[0][:7] == b"\x7fELF\x01\x01\x01"
    assert head[2] == 40 and head[4] == 0x0b000009 and head[9] == 32
    segments = []
    for index in range(head[10]):
        at = head[5] + index * head[9]
        assert at + 32 <= len(data)
        typ, offset, va, pa, filesz, memsz, flags, alignment = struct.unpack_from(
            "<8I", data, at)
        if typ != 1:
            continue
        assert offset + filesz <= len(data) and filesz == memsz
        assert va == pa and alignment == 4
        segments.append({"index": index, "offset": offset, "paddr": pa,
                         "filesz": filesz, "memsz": memsz, "flags": flags})
    assert [(s["paddr"], s["memsz"], s["flags"]) for s in segments] == list(PHYSICAL)
    stack, vector = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, segments[0]["offset"])
    assert stack == 0xe8000 and vector == 9
    return segments, stack, vector, head[4]


def diagnostic_worker(args):
    out = Path(args.out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    proof = json.loads(Path(args.preflight).read_text())
    assert proof["passed"] is True and proof["all_passed"] is True
    assert proof["expected_checks"] == PREFLIGHT_CHECKS
    assert len(proof["checks"]) == PREFLIGHT_CHECKS
    assert all(x["passed"] is True for x in proof["checks"])
    assert proof["qemu_sha256"] == digest(args.qemu)
    assert proof["runner_sha256"] == digest(__file__)
    assert os.getsid(0) == os.getpid(), "_worker must be started by diagnose-private"
    data = Path(args.firmware).read_bytes()
    segments, stack, vector, entry = parse_firmware(data)
    record = {"schema": "aop-qemu-entry-reference-diagnostic-v1",
              "qemu_sha256": digest(args.qemu), "runner_sha256": digest(__file__),
              "input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
              "preflight_sha256": digest(args.preflight),
              "profile": args.profile, "reference_cpu": "cortex-m3",
              "actual_aop_cpu": "unknown", "full_firmware_start": False,
              "hardware_reset_verified": False, "aop_startup_validated": False,
              "firmware_read": True, "completed_single_steps": 0,
              "steps_attempted": 0, "firmware_execution_requested": False, "maximum_steps": STEP_LIMIT,
              "raw_instruction_bytes_exported": False,
              "host_hooks_replacing_firmware_functions": False,
              "successful_peripheral_responses": 0}
    try:
        with Reference(args.qemu, out / "machine", args.profile) as r:
            record["qemu_reference_initial_state_before_loading"] = r.initial
            for segment in segments:
                start = segment["offset"]
                r.rsp.write(segment["paddr"], data[start:start + segment["filesz"]])
            # Only core GDB registers are writable in this QEMU revision.
            # Read-only M-system registers retain the recorded reference reset.
            for i in range(13):
                r.rsp.set_reg("r%d" % i, 0)
            r.rsp.set_reg("lr", 0)
            r.rsp.set_reg("xpsr", 0x01000000)
            r.rsp.set_reg("sp", stack)
            r.rsp.set_reg("pc", (entry if args.profile == PROFILES[0] else vector)
                           & ~1)
            assert r.rsp.reg("msp") == stack
            record["unmeasured_zero_seeds"] = ["r%d" % i for i in range(13)] + ["lr"]
            record["seeded_reference_state"] = r.state()
            record["candidate_stack_is_in_writable_range"] = contains(
                layout(args.profile), stack - 4, 4, 2)
            record["watchpoints"] = r.rsp.guards(layout(args.profile))
            before_bus = r.counts()
            save(out / "progress.json", record)
            recent = []
            for index in range(STEP_LIMIT):
                pc = r.rsp.reg("pc")
                width, stop_reason = instruction_size_and_stop(
                    r.rsp, layout(args.profile), pc)
                if stop_reason:
                    record["stop_reason"] = stop_reason
                    record["stopped_pc"] = pc
                    break
                recent.append({"pc": pc, "instruction_size": width})
                recent = recent[-16:]
                record["steps_attempted"] += 1
                record["firmware_execution_requested"] = True
                stop = r.rsp.step()
                address = watch_address(stop)
                if address is not None:
                    record["stop_reason"] = "unsupported-access-before-bus"
                    record["fault_address"] = address
                    record["stopped_pc"] = r.rsp.reg("pc")
                    record["debug_stop"] = stop
                    break
                record["completed_single_steps"] += 1
                if (index + 1) % 32 == 0:
                    record["recent_instruction_locations"] = recent
                    save(out / "progress.json", record)
                if r.rsp.reg("xpsr") & 0x1ff:
                    record["stop_reason"] = "architectural-exception-after-step"
                    record["exception_number"] = r.rsp.reg("xpsr") & 0x1ff
                    record["stopped_pc"] = r.rsp.reg("pc")
                    break
            else:
                record["stop_reason"] = "instruction-budget"
            record["recent_instruction_locations"] = recent
            record["final_state"] = r.state()
            record["unsupported_bus_counts_before"] = before_bus
            record["unsupported_bus_counts_after"] = r.counts()
            record["invalid_backing_padding_unchanged"] = r.qmp.get(
                "padding-pristine")
            assert record["unsupported_bus_counts_after"] == before_bus
            assert record["invalid_backing_padding_unchanged"] is True
            record["diagnostic_completed"] = True
            record["terminated_by"] = "host-qmp-quit"
    except BaseException:
        record["diagnostic_completed"] = False
        record["exception"] = traceback.format_exc()
    save(out / "result.json", record)
    return 0 if record.get("diagnostic_completed") else 1


def run_private(args):
    out = Path(args.out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    summary = {"aop_startup_validated": False, "hardware_reset_verified": False,
               "full_firmware_start": False, "profiles": []}
    for index, profile in enumerate(PROFILES):
        target = out / ("%02d" % index)
        command = [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "_worker",
                   "--qemu", str(Path(args.qemu).resolve()), "--out", str(target),
                   "--firmware", str(Path(args.firmware).resolve()),
                   "--preflight", str(Path(args.preflight).resolve()),
                   "--profile", profile]
        with (out / ("%02d.log" % index)).open("wb") as log:
            started = time.monotonic()
            worker = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=log,
                                      stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                      start_new_session=True)
            try:
                rc = worker.wait(timeout=HARD_SECONDS)
                status = {"profile": profile, "exit_code": rc}
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                # Kill the whole private worker/QEMU process group.  Killing
                # only the Python parent could leave a disconnected QEMU alive.
                os.killpg(worker.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                worker.wait(timeout=2)
                status = {"profile": profile, "hard_timeout_seconds": HARD_SECONDS,
                          "diagnostic_completed": False,
                          "entire_worker_process_group_killed": True}
            status["wall_seconds"] = time.monotonic() - started
        summary["profiles"].append(status)
        save(out / "summary.json", summary)
    return 0 if all(x.get("exit_code") == 0 for x in summary["profiles"]) else 1


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="operation", required=True)
    for name in ("preflight", "diagnose-private", "_worker"):
        sub = commands.add_parser(name)
        sub.add_argument("--qemu", required=True, type=Path)
        sub.add_argument("--out", required=True, type=Path)
        if name != "preflight":
            sub.add_argument("--firmware", required=True, type=Path)
            sub.add_argument("--preflight", required=True, type=Path)
        if name == "_worker":
            sub.add_argument("--profile", choices=PROFILES, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.operation == "preflight":
        return run_preflight(args)
    if args.operation == "_worker":
        return diagnostic_worker(args)
    return run_private(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
